package.name: burgerbot_companion
package.description:
Human-aware companion behaviour: who to attend to, when to approach, when to dance, and when to stop pestering somebody who keeps walking away.
All of the judgement lives in social.py and heatmap.py, which have no ROS dependency and are unit tested on synthetic people -- the same pure-logic split burgerbot_expressions uses for gestures and burgerbot_exploration uses for frontiers. It matters more here than anywhere else in this workspace, because you cannot ask somebody to walk away from a robot three times on cue, and certainly not reproducibly.
Sits on top of everything else and is required by none of it. Expression goes through mood_arbiter's bid inlet rather than straight to the face, body motion goes through the gesture server's feasibility gate, and approaches go through Nav2 -- so every existing safety and arbitration layer still applies to a robot that has started following people around.
